question.text: The number of distinct solutions of the equation, <math><mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">log</mi></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo></mrow></mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo><mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">log</mi></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></msub></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow></math> in the interval <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo></math> is ________

solution.text:
log1/2⁡sin⁡x=2-log1/2⁡cos⁡x
